mapper.select: SELECT w.USRID, w.stock_code, w.stock_name, w.exchange_code, w.group_id, w.is_favorite, w.created_at, sm.market_type AS marketType, ap.prediction_score AS aiScore FROM watchlist w LEFT JOIN stock_master sm ON w.stock_code = sm.stock_code LEFT JOIN ai_prediction ap ON ap.id = ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = CONCAT('STOCK_', w.stock_code) ) WHERE w.USRID = #{usrId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
SELECT DISTINCT stock_code, exchange_code, is_favorite FROM watchlist

SELECT w.USRID, w.stock_code, w.stock_name, w.exchange_code, w.group_id, w.is_favorite, w.created_at, sm.market_type AS marketType, ap.prediction_score AS aiScore FROM watchlist w LEFT JOIN stock_master sm ON w.stock_code = sm.stock_code LEFT JOIN ai_prediction ap ON ap.id = ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = CONCAT('STOCK_', w.stock_code) ) WHERE w.USRID = #{usrId} AND w.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC

SELECT w.USRID, w.stock_code, w.stock_name, w.exchange_code, w.group_id, w.is_favorite, w.created_at, sm.market_type AS marketType, ap.prediction_score AS aiScore FROM watchlist w LEFT JOIN stock_master sm ON w.stock_code = sm.stock_code LEFT JOIN ai_prediction ap ON ap.id = ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM ai_prediction WHERE target_name = CONCAT('STOCK_', w.stock_code) ) WHERE w.USRID = #{usrId} AND w.is_favorite = true ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist (USRID, stock_code, stock_name, exchange_code, group_id, is_favorite, created_at) VALUES (#{usrId}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{exchangeCode}, #{groupId}, #{isFavorite}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM watchlist WHERE USRID = #{usrId} AND stock_code = #{stockCode} AND group_id = #{groupId}
DELETE FROM watchlist WHERE USRID = #{usrId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT video_id, stock_code, stock_name, title, thumbnail_url, channel_name, view_count_str, published_at FROM youtube_feeds WHERE usr_id = #{usrId} AND published_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ORDER BY published_at DESC
